description: Fixture for meta-node invisibility (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §2, §6 item 9). Under Section, sibling order is [Rate, Config, Item]; Config is is_meta=true so it and its descendant Secret are invisible to formulas and skipped by positional operators. Node content is a single 'formula' field (§6): '' is the node-level Empty value, a leading = is a formula, and any other entry is a literal constant.
